resources.string: Reveal the system bars or use Android Back to show CTRL for 4 seconds.
Physical controller connected. Touch controls hide automatically; turn them on here to use both together.
Performance overlay (frame rate, 1% low, frame time graph; can cost a few frames)
40 fps (120 Hz panel mode; from the next start)
Smoother 60 fps: 120 Hz panel mode (a frame that misses 16.7 ms shows after 25 ms instead of 33; from the next start)
Depth of field (blur effect; off is sharper and faster)
Eco mode: less power and heat, lower image quality (the 3D scene is shaded at reduced detail and looks softer; HUD and text stay sharp)
Debug logging (statistics for troubleshooting; slight extra load; from the next start)
